title: Three-literal CNF padding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $F$ be a conjunctive normal form formula on $n$ variables. Its padded formula on $n+3$ variables has as clauses the concatenation, in the original order, of the padded clause lists obtained from each clause of $F$.
caveat: The snippet refers to `exactlyThreePadClause`, whose definition is not included, so its padding construction cannot be described more precisely.
